_noteW: W internal bin key IvernW is actually Brushmaker (icon-order swap vs UI slot letter guess in the original hint — verified against wiki: P/Q(Rootcaller)/W(Brushmaker)/E(Triggerseed)/R(Daisy!)). Brushmaker's own cast (grow a brush patch) deals zero damage; the real damage is a PASSIVE on-hit proc while Ivern (or allies within 1000u) stand in brush: TotalDamage = NamedDataValue(BaseDamage 12.5→... array) + StatByCoefficient(0.20, no mStat = AP per this engine's default) — DataValues confirm BaseDamage 20/27.5/35/42.5/50 (+20%AP) matching the wiki tooltip exactly. Modeled as a W bonusEffect (trigger onHit) rather than a direct 'hits' cast, since casting W itself does no damage. _noteE: E internal bin key IvernE is actually Triggerseed (see _noteW for the W/E identity correction). Triggerseed places a shield that explodes after 2s for real AoE magic damage to nearby enemies: TotalDamage = NamedDataValue(BaseDamage) + StatByNamedDataValue(DamageAPRatio=0.8) — DataValues confirm BaseDamage 70/90/110/130/150 (+80%AP), matching wiki exactly. This is a genuine direct-cast hit (delayed detonation), curated as a standard E hit.
_noteR: R (Daisy!) summons a pet (Daisy) that fights autonomously; the cast itself deals zero direct damage (only the initial summon counts as an ability activation). The bin's TotalShockwaveDamage calc (ShockwaveBaseDamage + 0.5 coefficient) represents Daisy's own 'Daisy Smash!' proc (confirmed Physical damage type on wiki) which triggers automatically after Daisy's 3rd consecutive basic attack on a target — it is DAISY's damage using DAISY's own total AD (itself scaled off Ivern's AP via TotalDaisyAD, a separate pet-stat calc), not a stat this engine's caster-bound resolver (bound to Ivern, the tracked champion) can access. Forcing it would silently apply Ivern's own AP/AD instead of the pet's, producing a fabricated number. Left unresolved — R slot omitted.
